mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in an easing monetary policy environment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a weakening labor market and impending economic slowdown, causing the S&P 500 to underperform by -0.5% over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3.0% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) fails to increase, the market anticipates a delayed policy response to inflation, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL 12m yoy > 3.0% AND FEDFUNDS change < 0.0% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing supply shock indicated by industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 (2017=100) disrupts corporate supply chains and reduces earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) consistently supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the labor market strength translates into economic growth.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) decline below 1000 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, causing the S&P 500 to underperform by -0.7% over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 3-month moving averages signal a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) indicates a manufacturing contraction, which disrupts supply chains and reduces corporate profitability, causing the S&P 500 to decline by -1.2% over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.
